name: Excel Reader
description: Streams a worksheet from an Excel workbook into DuckDB in bounded row chunks. Cells become typed columns from the header or the explicit column schema; blank header names get columnN placeholders and duplicate header names are rejected. Empty cells are NULL by default (as in csv_reader). Error cells and formulas without a cached value fail unless errorsAsNull is set. Time-only cells (formats without a date part) are read as Timestamp on the workbook epoch date, because Time is not offered yet.

file.title: Input file
file.description: Absolute path to the Excel workbook to read.

sheet.title: Sheet
sheet.description: Worksheet name or zero-based index as a string, e.g. "0"; the first sheet is used when omitted.

header.title: Header row
header.description: Whether the first row contains column names.

columns.title: Column schema
columns.description: Optional explicit column names and Arrow types; when omitted the header and type inference define the schema.

name.title: Name
name.description: Column name in the output table.

type.title: Type
type.description: Arrow data type of the column.

emptyStringIsNull.title: Empty string is null
emptyStringIsNull.description: Treat empty cells as NULL instead of empty strings. Defaults to true, matching csv_reader; set false to keep the legacy empty-string value.

errorsAsNull.title: Errors as null
errorsAsNull.description: Read error cells (#N/A, #DIV/0!, ...) and formulas without a cached value as NULL instead of failing with the cell reference.
